deliverables: Allocate capital to builders expected to improve monthly active users, monthly on-chain transactions, and TVL.
Require funded projects to track monthly active users, TVL, and on-chain transactions.
Continue development of KPI tracking, including movement toward live on-chain Cardano data.
Coordinate proposal evaluation, feedback, fund distribution, public reporting, and oversight through the Cardano Builder DAO.
Disburse funds only after milestone completion is validated and confirmed by the administrator.
request.recipient: Cardano Builder DAO, with funds initially received and administered by an independent council composed of dRep DAO members before milestone-based disbursement.
request.what: The proposal requests treasury funding for the Cardano Builder DAO, described as a smart contract-governed funding mechanism to allocate capital to builders advancing Cardano Vision 2030 KPIs.

claims.claim: The Cardano Builder DAO is intended to fund builders who can improve Cardano's monthly active users, monthly on-chain transactions, and TVL.
The DAO has already distributed 11.1 million ADA across 34 proposals in two funding rounds.
Round 1 involved 38 voting members, 27 requesting members, 20 funded companies, an 83% participation rate, and 5,541,335 ADA distributed through a smart contract-governed process.
Round 2 added 18 new DAO members, funded 14 companies, and achieved an 88% member participation rate.
The DAO has built Version 1 and Version 2 of a KPI dashboard, with Version 2 moving toward KPI tracking tied directly to live on-chain Cardano data.
Official Cardano developer documentation describes the CB DAO as a smart contract-governed mechanism with more than 50 established Cardano projects participating in funding decisions.

Treasury funds held by the administrator before disbursement will be kept in separate community-auditable accounts, not delegated to a stake pool, and delegated to the predefined abstain voting option.

All milestones will be disbursed from an independent multisig governed by assigned dRep DAO members, and the Cardano Builder DAO receives funds only after milestone completion is validated by the administrator.
Unused or unallocated DAO treasury funds after completion of approved work or funding activities would be returned to the Cardano Treasury.
The CB DAO returned 354,790 ADA of unused funds to the treasury after its first two governance rounds, with an AdaStat transaction link provided.

summary: The document requests 20,000,000 ADA for the Cardano Builder DAO to continue a KPI-oriented builder funding mechanism, citing prior funding rounds, governance participation, KPI dashboard work, administrator controls, milestone-based disbursement, and a prior unused-funds return.
